Hi Megan — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, details below:

- We support structured XML (UBL/Peppol) and PDF. For production-grade AP integrations we recommend XML via portal webhook or SFTP push.
- By default Redwood will list the configured billing contact as the invoice sender; we can put either a person + devops@ or a system address invoices@redwoodinference.com.
- We can include VAT tagging (reverse-charge) and attach the VAT certificate PDF to the invoice bundle.

Marissa (billing ops) and Hannah (AP onboarding) are looped in to confirm portal onboarding steps and sample payloads. If you prefer email copies only, we can send both PDF and an XML attachment to ap@acme-energy.com.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm whether you want portal webhook (preferred) or email delivery.
2) If webhook, share an IP allowlist + endpoint and we will provision and send a test XML.
3) If email, confirm filename/naming convention and whether your system expects one invoice per email or attachments grouped by PO.

I'll kick off the provisioning once you confirm.
